<!-- Bio adapted from the English LinkedIn "About" text Octave approved on 2026-11-14 (data/linkedin.md).
     Rewrite it freely in your own words. -->

I taught myself to program in Java, writing Minecraft mods and then a whole server network, long before engineering
school gave me the theory.

My master's thesis at TU Berlin was about LLM evaluation: what a single global leaderboard can hide when models
aren't good at the same things. I built the evaluation engine and compared up to 49 models. It also taught me how
fragile a score can be: in one test, changing nothing but the answer scorer reordered the models.

Alongside that, I've been freelancing since 2021, in development and Linux infrastructure.

[Research](research.qmd) · [GitHub](https://github.com/0ctave) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/octave-boelle)
